description: Trig ratios, identities, and the unit circle

cards.back:
sin θ = Opposite / Hypotenuse
cos θ = Adjacent / Hypotenuse
tan θ = Opposite / Adjacent

csc θ = 1/sin θ
sec θ = 1/cos θ
cot θ = 1/tan θ

sin²θ + cos²θ = 1

Derived forms:
• 1 + tan²θ = sec²θ
• 1 + cot²θ = csc²θ
